guide.text: Significantly increases HP. Since Wonder Woman's shield skill and [Stunned] debuff require her to stay in the front row, higher HP lets her reliably fulfill her role as a Guardian.
Significantly increases HP. Bane heals based on his max HP, so a larger HP pool means stronger sustained healing, making him even tankier.
Significantly increases HP. Shazam gains a shield from his dash skill, and with a larger HP pool and his revival, he becomes a highly dependable front-row Guardian.
Significantly increases HP. Doctor Fate's shield strength scales with his attribute, so higher HP lets him apply stronger shields, providing a direct boost to his protective power.
Significantly increases HP. Red Robin's skill grants him a shield based on his HP, so a larger HP pool boosts the shield strength and improves his overall survivability.
Significantly increases HP. At low HP, Killer Croc restores HP and lunges at the enemy with the highest Attack, and a large HP pool means more HP restored.
Significantly increases HP. Martian Manhunter needs to stay in the front row to take damage and trigger his counterattacks, so high HP is essential for him to stay in the fight.
Significantly increases HP. At max mark stacks, Donna gains a shield and boosts damage of [Amazons] allies. High HP allows her to keep dealing damage even after the shield disappears.
Significantly increases HP. Artemis needs to take heavy damage in duels, and a large HP pool ensures she survives to slash the target.
